cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Mrs. Herbert Fleischaker, San Francisco, California, c. 1924; [. . .]; (William Zierler, Inc., New York, NY); Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 2914, lot no. 92, 22 October 1969; ACA Galleries, New York, NY, 1969; William W. Collins, New York, NY, 1970; Mr. and Mrs. Abe Adler, New York, NY, 1975; (ACA Galleries, New York, NY); Private collection, San Antonio, Texas, 1981 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Infor. from Miss O'Keeffe, 1946. In 1924 exhibition, painted 1923. Sold to Mrs. Herbert Fleischaker. . . . Letter from Mr. Herbert Fleischacker: '. . . I am sorry to state that Mrs. Fleischacker gave these pictures away years ago and therefore cannot be of assistance to you.'" Backing inscription dates 1922. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Dated 1919 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. Reproduction in auction catalogue, 1969, confused with cat. no. 300. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Pink Gladiolus

description: A pale pink gladiolus sits at the center of the composition. It is surrounded by smaller, darker pink buds. Gradients of light and dark blue form the simple background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
